Definition: from G2316 and G3164; an opponent of deity:--to fight against God.
BiblicalUsage: The word theomáchos is the Bible's way of saying one who fights against God. In Acts 5:39, if it be of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that to be found fighting against God is the most terrible place a person can stand.
